sections.markdown:
## C2 — Graduated license confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A86
A 17-year-old is free of the graduated rules only after holding a valid license for 6 months, while anyone 18 or older is exempt outright. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint gdl-exemptions; prereq_hint sec13-F01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F01, sec13-F02.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A86
A 15-year-old learner's supervisor must be a parent, a guardian, a licensed driver at least 21 or a driving instructor, while the passenger limit for restricted drivers allows only 1 nonfamily passenger. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint gdl-supervision; prereq_hint sec13-F06; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F07, sec13-F10.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A86
A restriction violation adds no points and brings no criminal penalty, yet it still extends the restricted period by 6 months or until 18. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint gdl-enforcement; prereq_hint sec13-F15; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F17, sec13-F18.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A86
Breaking a restriction extends the graduated period, but a second moving violation or a four-point offense brings an automatic 60-day suspension. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint gdl-penalties; prereq_hint sec13-F18; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec13-F19, sec13-F20.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A86
Driving between 12 midnight and 6 a.m. is allowed with a parent or guardian, while riding with another adult licensee 21 or older also needs parental consent. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint gdl-curfew; prereq_hint sec13-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F12, sec13-F13.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A86
A GDL citation is never written on its own; the officer must first stop and cite the driver for a separate violation. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint gdl-enforcement; prereq_hint sec13-F15; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec13-F16.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0086]
